# Test fixtures

`portrait.jpg` is the top of Michael Ancher's *Pigen med solsikkerne* (1889), a painting in the public domain, from the [Statens Museum for Kunst's photograph on Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Michael_Ancher,_Pigen_med_solsikkerne,_1889,_KMS3820,_Statens_Museum_for_Kunst.jpg). The background blur test uses it as a camera frame: a person before a detailed room, with no real person's photograph in the repository.
